arguments.message:
Sure! To set up a recurring export to cloud storage:
1. Open **Settings → Data → Scheduled exports**.
2. Choose the data you want to export and set the recurrence (daily, weekly, or monthly).
3. Connect your cloud storage destination (Meridian supports the major providers via a one‑time OAuth connection).
4. Save the schedule.
Each run will create a new file in the connected storage, and you can view the history and status of each export on the Scheduled exports screen.
